# Error #63: OwnershipProposalPending

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#63`
- **Variant Name**: `OwnershipProposalPending`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `WARNING`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::ProposeAlreadyPending` — an unexpired ownership proposal already exists for the stream.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::second_proposal_while_one_is_pending_reverts`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::second_proposal_while_one_is_pending_reverts). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// ProposeAlreadyPending — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
let first = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
let second = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .propose_ownership_transfer(&f.sender, &id, &first);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_propose_ownership_transfer(&f.sender, &id, &second)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked second_proposal_while_one_is_pending_reverts
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Cancel the existing unexpired ownership proposal or wait for it to expire before proposing another transfer.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer)
